No redesign, no added details, no shadows, no texture, no letters, no surrounding shape. Crop away the large blank margins and center the complete emblem on a transparent square canvas so it spans 98% of the canvas width with its natural aspect ratio. Output a clean sharp black monochrome silhouette with transparent negative spaces. The emblem must remain completely visible.
assets.processing: Alpha bounds fitted to 63/64 of the icon width without distortion. SVG alpha mask uses black in light mode and white in dark mode. ICO fallback contains 16, 32 and 48 pixel entries.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Image 1 is the user's ORIGINAL WEBSITE CONCEPT, the exact art-direction reference. Create ONLY a high-resolution standalone version of the book-and-tree illustration in its top-right hero. Match this specific original closely: loose scratchy graphite, delicate transparent watercolour, airy cream paper, dusty lavender sky, small round owl with round wire glasses flying, round hedgehog with russet scarf below. The other two images are exact Mo and Ella identity references. Keep proportions and natural hand-drawn mark-making of these sheets. Show an upright lavender book, almost front facing with subtle perspective and cream page edge, a large tree to the right and a few wildflowers/moss at its base. The title on the cover is exactly 'Ella’s Night Flight' in elegant dark brown literary serif over 2 lines, subtitle 'A Life of Mo Story'. Keep the book large and legible, 85% image height. Landscape 3:2 composition, whole book and tree visible. Background flat warm cream #F8F3E5, vignette edges fading softly into the cream. No website text or buttons. Restrained palette, lots of pale paper, no cinematic glowing sunset, no dense photorealistic vegetation, no polished digital rendering. High resolution, crisp fine graphite marks. The final asset must feel like the original concept illustration, not a reimagined fantasy scene.

assets.role: Previous generated storybook preview; retained as an unused asset
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Image 1 is the exact original Life of Mo website concept. Create ONLY a standalone high-resolution version of the open storybook in its second section. The other 2 images show exact Mo and Ella character identity. Recreate the original open-book composition: very wide landscape 2.2:1, complete book and cream page edges visible, laid open with gentle central fold. An airy graphite and delicate watercolour illustration runs across both pages: Mo the little hedgehog with russet scarf on the lower left watching Ella the owl with large round glasses on a LOW branch near the centre, woodland lake and distant pines on the right, very pale lavender-peach evening sky. Matching original's sparse paper texture, scratchy graphite and gentle watercolour. Keep generous clear pale areas for story text. Put exactly this text in small dark brown serif on the LEFT pale upper area: '“You can do it,” Mo said.' and on the RIGHT pale upper area: 'Ella spread her wings and took a shaky breath.' Preserve the original character scale and identity, but avoid copying website UI. Cream #F8F3E5 outside the book, near invisible soft shadow. No exaggerated shadows, no artificial 3D page curvature, no dense glowing digital scene. No labels, no website text, no watermarks. Entire book occupies most of width with a small clear margin.

assets.role: Previous founder story woodland vignette; retained as an unused asset
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. First reference is the original Life of Mo website concept. Recreate only its small founder-story woodland vignette (near the bottom, Mo sitting on a rock), as a standalone high-resolution landscape 2:1 artwork. Second reference is the exact Mo identity: round hedgehog, pale face, small black nose and eyes, russet scarf, scratchy graphite quills. Mo sits on a mossy rock at left beneath an old tree, looking with quiet curiosity at a few tiny golden fireflies, distant pines and a very pale lavender evening sky. Keep the original's airy, delicate watercolour and graphite style; plenty of light warm cream paper and loosely drawn wildflowers. Natural uneven edges dissolve into solid warm cream #F8F3E5 at all sides. A small intimate moment, not a dramatic vista. Same character identity as the supplied sheet, no invented accessories. No text, no frame, no circle, no website UI, no photographic rendering, no heavy digital glow.
